assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Isosceles triangle ABC with apex A on top and base BC at the bottom. A grey dashed axis runs from A down to the midpoint of BC. On it, a larger blue circle with centre O1 touches BC and both legs, and a smaller blue circle with centre O2 sits above it, touching it and both legs. Red radii to the points of tangency on AC, with right-angle marks, are labelled 2 and 1.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
